notes: The owner's Test cleared the certificate rung and stalled one higher: *authenticating — it did not answer in time*, on both JIDs. The silence was ours. AN XMPP SESSION IS THREE STREAMS, AND THE DRIVER ONLY RESTARTED ITS READER FOR THE FIRST HANDOVER. The STARTTLS restart goes through the lifecycle's restart_stream action, which resets the XML reader. The POST-SASL restart (RFC 6120 §6.4.6) is initiated BY THE CORE, which writes the new stream header itself on success — and the driver never reset the reader for it. The third stream's root then arrived as a CHILD of the second stream's still-ope
